decisions.decision: killSwitch=true — Always-on VPN with block-without-VPN: no fallback to the bare interface on tunnel drop.
blockIpv6=true — No IPv6 routes until the tunnel carries IPv6; an unrouted v6 stack leaks silently.
allowLan=false — LAN bypass off (InviZible-style firewall posture); exceptions are per-app and explicit.
tunMtu=1400 — tun-mtu 1400 / mssfix 1360 avoids fragmentation blackholes behind carrier NAT.
dnsLeakProtection=true — All DNS forced through the encrypted path; no system resolver fallback.
dnsMode=dnscrypt — DNSCrypt is reached through the VPN tunnel; the local network sees neither plaintext DNS nor the resolver choice.
